t-flow.text: STEP 0 · READ THESE FIRST — F1 is the build order; every box links to its screen. F2 is the single resolver every QR goes through.

n-Flow-System.dc.html.text: HOW TO READ: five swimlanes = who acts. Arrows = order. Every box links to its screen. Build in this order: Step 1 → 5. Refs (A1, T1, 6…) match board titles.

n-Flow-Scan.dc.html.text: THE ONE RESOLVER: every QR hits /d/<token> or /p/<token>. Server decides device vs passport, valid vs not, who you are → which screen. No other entry points.

t-s1.text: STEP 1 · DEVICES IN (Track0tic admin) — register supplier → receive → QC (SIM bound, TRK ID) → QR labels: the label is printed at the moment the device is allocated to a tenant.

n-Admin-Login.dc.html.text: Staff only (Track0tic employees). Email + password; 2FA step shown but repo has none yet (phase 2). 5 failures → 15 min lock. Tenant users never log in here.

n-Admin-Suppliers.dc.html.text: WHY: a device can only be received against a registered supplier + approved model. Keeps warranty/RMA, drives QC sampling by fail rate. Supplier is a record, NOT a tenant — no login. Warranty 12/18/24/36 m.

n-Admin-Receive.dc.html.text: Creates devices as inactive · unlabelled. Serials pasted or CSV, or arrive by "hello" message from an allowed factory. No TRK ID yet. Partial receipt allowed. Batch id RB-####.

n-Admin-QC.dc.html.text: Bench check per device: power, telemetry seen, firmware = target, probe ±0.3 °C, enclosure, battery. SIM BOUND recorded here (ICCID + M2M whitelist). PASS assigns TRK ID + queues label. FAIL → RMA to supplier.

n-Admin-DeviceLabels.dc.html.text: THE ONE QR SCREEN (decided 29 Oct): 1 pick tenant → 2 device type + quantity → Print device QRs = allocation to that tenant (labels permanent, 60×30, /d/<token>) → 3 passport QR quantity + size + cartons + who prints → Generate book. Track0tic prints & couriers, or tenant prints from T1. Tenant top-up requests load into step 3. PDF default; ZPL = raw thermal-label-printer format, optional.

n-Admin-Inventory.dc.html.text: Stages: awaiting QC → SIM bound → QC pass/unlabelled → in stock → allocated → maintenance/revoked. Click a stage card = filter. Bulk: allocate, print, maintenance, revoke.

n-Admin-DeviceDetail.dc.html.text: One device: live temp, battery, drift (live rows only), passports on it (all legs — admin sees everything), identity, device_events timeline. Revoke = dead link on scan.

t-s2.text: STEP 2 · TENANT & SALE (Track0tic admin → tenant portal) — create tenant → tenant page asks for first admin → profile & journey → allocate devices → issue passports → tenant prints.

n-Admin-Tenants.dc.html.text: Create COMPANY only. Vertical drives everything below it (categories, Hosted on, profile, journey, quota, print rights). Saves → opens tenant page which demands the first admin. BFSI → dedicated environment (Muthoot/Axis), never shared.

n-Admin-TenantDetail.dc.html.text: Amber banner until first tenant admin exists — nothing can be allocated before that (server rule). Tabs: devices, passports, users, settings. Every setting change needs a reason → audit.

n-Admin-Users.dc.html.text: Track0tic-side view of a tenant's users (ADMIN/OPS_SUPPORT may add/disable). Tenant admin normally does this in T6. Tenant dropdown drives all numbers + list.

n-Admin-Profiles.dc.html.text: Profile = range + grace + cumulative limit → decides "in range". Applies to legs starting after save; closed legs never re-graded. Switches: alert custodian, previous custodian, ISSUING tenant.

n-Admin-Journeys.dc.html.text: Template = EXPECTATION, never enforcement. Binds are never blocked. Chain is dynamic (2…n legs). Each leg gets its patient-PDF word: Storage / Transit / Not monitored. Deviations → Exceptions.

n-Admin-Allocate.dc.html.text: Detail of A3 step 2: the allocation record (invoice, delivery note, specific TRK IDs). Writes devices.tenant_id + ALLOCATED event + audit. Devices stay inactive until first telemetry/bind.

n-Admin-Issue.dc.html.text: Detail of A3 step 3: books issued per tenant, stock, prints. Track0tic MINTS every passport QR; tenants never do. Carton QR binds all inside. Tenant dropdown drives everything.

n-Tenant-Stock.dc.html.text: Tenant portal. Books issued to this tenant; print at 100 %, PRINT is an audit event (who/when/which codes). Request more → Approvals. Cannot mint.

n-Labels-Sheet.dc.html.text: ONE label type for everything that moves: PASSPORT QR — standard 40×25, tube size 25×12, carton flag. Device QR 60×30 (HUB 80×40). QR encodes full URL never bare id; 8-char short code under every passport QR.

t-s3.text: STEP 3 · FIELD (phone, any tenant) — sign in → scan device → bind → hand over → next custodian repeats. Error and offline states follow.

n-Field-Login.dc.html.text: Any tenant user. Mobile + OTP only. Session 8 h. Location permission asked here, required for pharma binds.

n-Main.dc.html.text: Device QR scanned, NOT logged in: public device view — type, status, "log in to bind". Never shows passports or location.

n-Device-Staff.dc.html.text: Device QR scanned by a user of the OWNING tenant: live temp, what is on it, Bind / Hand over. Same page for HUB, PRO, LITE, LOCKBOX. Other tenant → F1 "not your device".

n-Bind-Sheet.dc.html.text: Camera + typed 8-char code ALWAYS both. Each bind saved instantly. Carton = all inside. ONE DEVICE AT A TIME: a new bind releases the previous binding and closes that leg. Typed binds tagged TYPED.

n-Passport-Issued.dc.html.text: Passport QR scanned by staff before first bind: ISSUED, no legs. Offer: bind to a device.

n-Passport-Staff.dc.html.text: Passport QR scanned by custodian/staff: journey newest first — own legs + the one received from (grants widen). Hand over / Bind. Custodian PDF (D2).

n-Carton-Handover.dc.html.text: Bulk handover at a stop: tick cartons (all inside) and loose units. Location captured. "split" → F5a when only part of a carton stays.

n-Carton-Split.dc.html.text: Part of a carton stays: units that leave KEEP every step travelled inside the carton, then start their own leg; carton continues with the rest. Nothing reprinted. Scanning one unit's own QR = same.

n-Handover-Confirm.dc.html.text: Closes the leg(s): location, count, receiver optional. Next custodian binding to own device is ALSO a handover (no need for this screen).

n-Receiver-Ack.dc.html.text: Receiver with no device: acknowledge (optional, never a gate) so sender sees arrival; or bind to own device later. Sees own leg + the one received from.

n-Bind-Offline.dc.html.text: No signal: last code kept on screen, NEVER auto-retried (no double binds). Earlier binds already saved server-side.

n-Err-NotYourDevice.dc.html.text: Logged in, device belongs to another tenant → bind to your own device instead. Server returns 403 with tenant name hidden.

n-Err-InvalidCode.dc.html.text: Unknown token / mistyped code. Same page for a non-existent passport. On bank environments this page = ALL unauthorised scans (never confirm existence).

n-Err-LabelReplaced.dc.html.text: PHASE 2. Old device sticker after token rotation → "label replaced". Open passports unaffected.

n-Err-Void.dc.html.text: Passport VOID (staff only, with reason): no history shown publicly; owning tenant keeps history; future binds rejected.

t-s4.text: STEP 4 · PATIENT (public, no login) — scan passport → compliance PDF opens: whole chain anonymised, last leg in detail. D2 is what the custodian gets instead.

n-Passport-Public.dc.html.text: Patient scans → PDF opens INLINE (Content-Disposition inline), no landing page. Whole chain anonymised, last leg detailed. No names/places/TRK IDs. Bank environments: 404.

n-Cert-Public.dc.html.text: 6 STATES in props: COMPLIANT · NOT COMPLIANT step N · COMPLIANT WHERE MONITORED (no device or missing readings) · JOURNEY IN PROGRESS (open leg, snapshot + generation time) · NOT YET IN A JOURNEY (never bound). Cached per closed leg; in-progress generated live.

n-Cert-Staff.dc.html.text: Custodian copy: names, places, device ids for OWN legs + adjacent handovers. Legs close on device time (last_recorded_at), never phone clock. Not for public distribution.

t-s5.text: STEP 5 · OPERATIONS (admin + tenant) — dashboard, alerts, approvals, void, custody lists, exceptions, grants, reports, audit, staff.

n-Admin-Dashboard.dc.html.text: Staff landing: alerts, approvals, stale HUB bindings, device pipeline (received → SIM bound → QC → labelled → stock → customers), passports, latest events.

n-Admin-Alerts.dc.html.text: Excursion open/closed, silent device with open legs, leg over template, clock drift. Filter chips. Merge action per alert type.

n-Admin-Approvals.dc.html.text: Tenant requests only Track0tic may grant. Each card states exactly what approving does. Decision + note → SMS to requester + audit. Label replacement cards are PHASE 2.

n-Admin-VoidPassport.dc.html.text: Only way a passport leaves play. Reason (public) + note (internal) + typed code to confirm. Closes open leg with reason VOID. Irreversible.

n-Tenant-Custody.dc.html.text: Tenant: every passport ON its devices, grouped by device. Own legs + received-from only. Links to custodian PDF.

n-Tenant-Exceptions.dc.html.text: Drift from template/profile: excursion open, leg over template, unexpected device. Resolve with a remark (goes on certificate) or escalate to Track0tic → Approvals.

n-Tenant-Grants.dc.html.text: Widen visibility for a partner on passports you share (never narrow, never public). Not on bank environments.

n-Admin-Reports.dc.html.text: Issued, binds/day (SCAN vs TYPED), legs in range %, open legs over template, device health, public scans. Tenant + period filters must drive all cards (wireframe cards are static).

n-Admin-AuditLog.dc.html.text: Append-only, 7 y. Every write incl. BIND, HANDOVER, VOID, ALLOCATE, ISSUE, PRINT, APPROVAL, LOGIN_FAIL, CRON. Who / from where / before-after.

n-Admin-StaffUsers.dc.html.text: Track0tic staff roles: ADMIN · OPS_SUPPORT · WAREHOUSE · VIEWER with capability matrix. Invite by @trackotic.com email, 24 h link.

t-s6.text: VERTICALS — same flow, different words: diagnostics (tube → bag → lab HUB) and BFSI pods (no public route, lockbox opening).

n-Diag-Collect.dc.html.text: Diagnostics: tube carries a PASSPORT QR (tube size). Phlebotomist scans tube at patient → binds to LITE bag. Oldest-tube timer vs 4 h template.

n-Diag-Bench.dc.html.text: Lab bench: scanning tube into lab HUB releases the bag binding automatically and closes that leg. CHECK flag when bag peaked or over 4 h.

n-BFSI-Passport.dc.html.text: Bank environment: passport QR on pouch/packet. Page opens only from allow-listed branch IP + signed-in custodian. No public certificate, no location shown.

n-Lockbox-Device.dc.html.text: Lockbox = device QR like any other (bind pouches). Opening is extra: split code, two custodians. Firmware-dependent — parked until hardware team delivers.

t-s7.text: SHARED PIECES — sidebar component, non-happy states, SMS copy.

n-Admin-Sidebar.dc.html.text: Component used by every admin page. Order = workflow: Devices → Tenants → Sale & supply → Operations → Admin. Active item passed as prop.

n-Empty-States.dc.html.text: Every list has empty / loading / error / no-access states in one shape: one line what, one line what to do, one button. Bank environments: unauthorised = 404 look-alike.

n-SMS-Copy.dc.html.text: All SMS ≤160 GSM-7, DLT-registered templates, sender TRKOTC. Never a location or another tenant's name. Quiet hours except OTP/lockbox. Issuer alert names the step, never the custodian.

s-rules.text: Rules carried from the spec: public pages never show location, tenant names or TRK ids. Passport never closes. Typed binds are tagged. Track0tic issues every passport. 28 Oct: the public scan opens the compliance PDF for the WHOLE chain (anonymised — Storage/Transit steps), last leg in detail. DECIDED 28 Oct: a passport is on ONE device at a time — a new bind releases the previous binding automatically (that leg closes). Any missing readings or missing device → verdict "COMPLIANT WHERE MONITORED" (D1 chain "with-gap-and-breach" shows both kinds of gap).

s-chain.text: Chain is dynamic: could be 2 steps (retail HUB → Pro → patient) or 8 (manufacturer HUB → Pro → CFA HUB → Pro → distributor HUB → Pro → retail HUB → Pro). Carton legs at the manufacturer are inherited by every unit inside. Verdict: COMPLIANT · NOT COMPLIANT at step N · COMPLIANT WHERE MONITORED (gap).

s-hindi.text: Hindi: every field string exists in Hindi too (design system rule). Same layout, same sizes; the toggle sits in the app bar. Not drawn twice here — copy sheet to follow from the content team.

s-gaps.text: PHASE 2 (not drawn): (e) device return / de-allocation page (today only via Approvals); (f) reference data admin page (sales categories, states, locations). DONE 29 Oct: journey-in-progress + not-yet-bound PDF states (D1), carton split (F5a), issuer alert SMS + profile switch.

s-logo.text: BRAND (28 Oct): wordmark is Track0tic™ everywhere — the 0 is a zero in red (#e11d2e; #ff5a66 on dark), never the letter O, never blue; ™ superscript always follows. Applies to app bars, admin sidebar, PDFs, labels, SMS sender name text.

n-Admin-Trips.dc.html.text: EXISTING trips module, unchanged (trip · device · driver · vehicle · window · invoice report). New: passports bound to the trip's device during the trip are listed under it and on the invoice report. Trip ≠ passport leg: a passport bound mid-trip gets a leg from its bind time. Tenant filter drives everything.
